name: 公益文书助手
examples_zh: 我们机构想在腾讯公益上线一个乡村儿童阅读项目，帮我写一份项目申请书。
帮我写一份结项报告，项目是去年在支付宝公益上线的"困境老人陪伴计划"，已经执行完毕了。
我有一堆之前写的项目材料（Word 和 PDF），想按照字节跳动公益的规范重新整理归档。
examples_en: Our organization wants to launch a rural children's reading project on Tencent Charity — help me draft a project proposal.
Help me write a final report for our "Elderly Companionship Program" that was listed on Alipay Charity last year and has been completed.
I have a bunch of existing project documents (Word & PDF) that I'd like to reorganize and archive according to ByteDance Charity's standards.
description_zh: 面向公益从业者的一站式文书工作台。分步引导采集项目信息，自动适配各平台规范，生成可直接提交的专业文书；也可将已有材料一键标准化归档。覆盖腾讯公益、字节跳动公益、支付宝公益、微博微公益、京东公益、美团公益等平台。
description_en: All-in-one document workbench for nonprofit practitioners. Guides you step-by-step through project information collection, automatically adapts to each platform's requirements, and produces submission-ready documents. Also standardizes and archives existing materials in one click. Covers China's major public fundraising platforms plus vertical crowdfunding and foundation/hub platforms.
